children.value: > Fact From Story: Any illusion of the success of globalization, or of the twenty-first century representing a break from the brutal twentieth century, was stripped away with Russia’s most recent invasion of Ukraine.
> > Fact From Story: There is a faintly discernable storyline of general resistance and rebuilding imperfect democracies.

> > > > > Fact From Story: In this narration, the twenty-first century began with a wave of crushed democratic uprisings and continued with the election of authoritarian leaders around the world who began to dismantle democratic institutions.
> > > > > Fact From Story: The plot is less clear, given the failure of democracy-building efforts in the twentieth century.
> > > > > Commonsense Knowledge: Failed efforts are unclear successes.
